Yinyang appendices

Yinyang files and shared updates

This page documents the author's maintained source and private-instance file relationships. Public Full is a static reference, not for your own practice. Recipients start from Empty and follow its package contract.

This guide owns the file and update contract for the maintained Yinyang package. The collection is Prometheus2Heraclitus; this complete member lives under skills/yinyang/. Its references/docs/ and references/diagrams/ are supporting resources, not independent Skills. Obtain the complete directory from the public repository and expose it through the consumer's actual Skill mechanism. The website is a reading surface; repository cloning and GitHub's native ZIP preserve complete source.

Yinyang is one developed philosophy and formation method. Readers can adopt it, combine selected resources, or create a different work. The example and commons essay develops that invitation. A philosopher's thought may inform a framework; it cannot replace the account of the actual user. This guide's six-question, dual-route and common-update contract applies to full adoption of the maintained Skill. Reading its philosophy or borrowing a selected method does not by itself adopt that contract or require a personal philosophy project. Full adoption also leaves original essay-writing optional: its question-defined models state the positions and arrangements adopted for use, which can draw on selected existing ideas.

Common and situated content

The six bilingual formation guides define the full questions and reading roles of orientation, person, counterpart, relationship, environment and revision. Each synthesis instruction draws on the six complete guides and relevant actual grounds. Formation and revision owns their distinct subjects, connected scope and whole-six coherence.

The reference and method overview explains edition and condensation choices; this page locates the private files and their updates:

Question Actual private file
Orientation references/situated/orientation.md
Person references/situated/person.md
Counterpart references/situated/counterpart.md
Relationship references/situated/relationship.md
Environment references/situated/environment.md
Actual situated revision method references/situated/revision.md

Read all six complete actual accounts in ordinary collaboration. Persist intended private source in Git and a private GitHub repository through the actual account and publication owner, checking private visibility, committed content and reader retrieval. Original records retain their owners; secrets stay outside ordinary repository files. Public Full ships no private accounts or placeholders.

The complex route projects checked bodies to the same six paths, or binds the six questions, native IDs, and complete bodies through private references/situated/index.md. See Hindsight configuration. Formation and revision owns their content and whole-account checking.

Philosophy retains its authored source. Personal remains human-readable topic articles in the existing four subject groups, with usable navigation and original source links. Direct source/article editing remains available. In the native route, substantive Knowledge Pages can maintain those articles and project Markdown into existing private reading paths, with Observations backstage. Migrate affected derived articles as revision needs, preserving readability and unique grounds. Corrected Personal understanding must inform later synthesis; all products can return to originals without requiring chained generated summaries. The Personal guide owns that reading arrangement.

Keep meaningful Personal material names in the person's native language; body language follows its consumer. Preserve instrument identifiers where useful. Both references/personal/ and references/situated/, including optional native bindings and private generated bodies, stay private. Common projection protects both trees; it does not change bank state, GitHub visibility or runtime consumers. Independently authored philosophy retains its own source.

Questionnaire and assessment material

When a situated version has questionnaire or assessment records, organize this distinct part of personal evidence under references/personal/questionnaires/. Use its README.md as a readable inventory linking dated records and their original sources. Connect it from personal/README.md and personal/sources.md. Group records by occasion or instrument according to what makes them easy to retrieve; repeated completions remain separate dated observations.

Keep each record's instrument name, language and version when known, completion date and context, result and score direction, and access to original answers or the report. Distinguish a questionnaire response, a performance test, a report's written conclusion, and a later interpretation. Preserve conflicting findings and missing information explicitly; a report without item answers must not be expanded into invented responses. Existing private measurement systems and medical-document collections can retain their originals, with useful results and working links maintained here instead of duplicate archives. Undated material remains undated until its source establishes a date.

This organization makes measurements available alongside narrative material without turning them into a complete personal account or automatically revising the working models. The Psychology guide owns selection, scoring and interpretation. The directory and all filled records remain private; the distributed package supplies this organizing method, not another person's records or placeholder results.

Project common changes

scripts/sync-common.py checks common source projection by default. With --apply, it projects common files into the target, preserving everything under both private trees, including additional files and links. It does not traverse or inspect their contents. It does not infer a person, export private files, or publish to a runtime.

Start a new situated version from a complete shared copy, then form its private accounts. Compare explicit package directories:

python3 /path/to/shared/yinyang/scripts/sync-common.py \
  --source /path/to/shared/yinyang --target /path/to/situated/yinyang

Add --apply to copy changes, then run the comparison again. Unmatched target files and common-path symlinks stop copying; inspect ownership rather than silently deleting them. Existing local or private Web owners install and publish the projected source, followed by actual-consumer readback.

Earlier packages mixed public guidance and private content at references/{encounter,models,relationship,usage,sources}.md. The projector refuses either package with any of these paths before changing files. Their owner first migrates actual meaning into the six actual accounts and private evidence index, or an explicit all-six native binding, preserves unique support, and retires the old paths. The old encounter can contain orientation and relationship, and the old relationship both counterpart and joint activity: a mechanical rename cannot complete this semantic migration. Retain any useful private references/personal/README.md substance at the appropriate private owner; the whole personal tree is protected.

Common parity preserves one recipient-local discovery exception: when the target's single-line SKILL.md description already begins with <用户自制> and a space, the projector retains that prefix while replacing its substantive wording from the common source. An unmarked target stays unmarked. Every other common byte and file mode remains source-owned; the public package does not assign itself recipient-relative authorship.

This parity applies to copies choosing continuing common updates. If you replace the philosophy or organization independently, keep that work at its own source and maintain its coherent references. Do not project this common package over it, even if it retains the six-slot format.

The maintained implementation preserves the six full questions and their coherent relations through either route. Native paths may differ under an explicit all-six binding; independently authored works can choose another design.

Personal and public boundaries

Personal accounts remain private even when formalized or written for models. Private quotations, biography, psychological and health records, relationship narratives, account information, private paths and conversation identifiers, and unpublished manuscripts stay with their actual owners. General abstraction does not authorize public links that reconstruct private sources.

Return only authorized reusable insights to the collection. Yinyang original material uses CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; other independent members retain their own MIT licenses. Follow the collection guide and the actual publication owner for permissions, attribution, and source review. A private adaptation need not be published.
